parsed.explanation: No trans-presentation offence or documented birth-sex facility/custody rule is shown, and same-sex conduct is legal, preventing a lower rating. Against that, police are documented perpetrators: a 2016 LGBTIQ register, 2022-23 raids with forced HIV testing, arbitrary charges, ill-treatment, sexual abuse and extortion, and 2024 entrapment to register, harvest contacts and extort (10+ cases in one province; 27 recorded violations nationally in 2024 are raw counts, not per-capita rates). Surveillance raises outing risk, attitudes are described as entirely negative with hostile political/religious framing, forced/sham marriages meet police inaction, and there is no SOGI anti-discrimination protection or effective recourse. Border, facilities and trans-detention conditions are undocumented, not cleared. This is sustained state targeting with severe abuse and no remedy, consistent with high risk.
